headline: Weathered Expanse Still Heaviest Fight; Mooring County Wholly Warden
war_summary: The heaviest affray of the day remains Weathered Expanse, where twenty-two events were logged in six hours and eighty-three across the day. Its ledger shows 8,298 Colonial and 11,336 Warden casualties over twenty-four hours, its latest reported change at 11:42 this morning, and the ground divided into three Warden works, two Colonial and four unclaimed. Mooring County now stands wholly under Warden control, all twelve works, where the last edition found nine Warden, two Colonial and one unclaimed; the tempo there has broken, with one event in two hours against fifty in the day, and casualties falling from 7,884 Colonial and 8,505 Warden over twenty-four hours to sixty-four and forty-eight in the last two. Stlican Shelf reported six events in six hours at Briar and Breaker Town, holding one Warden work against eight Colonial. Marban Hollow and Callahan's Passage have logged nothing in six hours. Nevish Line shows heavy attrition, 5,051 Colonial and 5,231 Warden casualties in a day, with seven Warden works against one Colonial. The general ledger reads 303 Colonial works, 124 Warden and six unclaimed; thirty-four towns remain the mark for victory.
